n1888eff46a.headline: Algeria to hold tender for 1 million sheep before Eid al-Adha
n1888eff46a.summary: Algeria will issue an international tender to import 1 million sheep to meet local demand ahead of Eid al-Adha, according to Daily Sabah.
n1888eff46a.why: Large state livestock import tenders shape regional meat supply and food import spending.

nccf5a60d79.headline: Nissan chief steps down after Japanese car giant reports dismal results
nccf5a60d79.summary: Nissan chief executive Makoto Uchida will be replaced by chief planning officer Ivan Espinosa after the company reported dismal results. The change follows the weak earnings report.
nccf5a60d79.why: Nissan is a major Japanese automaker whose profitability and leadership changes affect its share price and the broader auto sector. Leadership turnover after weak results often signals a strategy reset.

n410fb956b9.headline: Morning news brief
n410fb956b9.summary: The Trump administration has permanently canceled 83% of USAID programmes following a six-week review, a move that will cost Kenyan jobs. The decision was described as overdue.
n410fb956b9.why: USAID is the US government agency that funds foreign aid and development programmes, which support economies and employment in recipient countries. Large cuts affect aid-dependent economies and contractors.

ncb7b995b7a.headline: Companies don't want to list on the stock exchange even if they are paid
ncb7b995b7a.summary: Three companies signed financing contracts in the first round of a project call but none were listed, and of three now registered one was rejected. A broker said companies do not list for small sums.
ncb7b995b7a.why: Stock exchange listings bring new equity supply and liquidity to a market, and a shortage of listings limits capital-market depth. Bucharest is Romania's main equity exchange.

n5406ca4e9f.headline: 'We want zero VAT’: MK Party marches against proposed increase
n5406ca4e9f.summary: Hundreds of Jacob Zuma-led MK Party supporters marched in Pretoria on Monday against a proposed two percentage point VAT increase. Supporters demanded zero VAT.
n5406ca4e9f.why: Value-added tax changes alter consumer prices and government revenue, so proposed increases are closely watched by investors assessing South Africa's fiscal policy.

n0c0e52a986.headline: Asian, US stock markets dip amid alarm over tariffs, recession
n0c0e52a986.summary: Asian benchmarks slid on Tuesday, following American peers lower on the previous close. Investors grew increasingly worried about the ripple effects of US tariffs.
n0c0e52a986.why: US tariff policy affects global trade and corporate earnings, and recession fears can reduce investor appetite for equities across Asia and the United States.
n0c0e52a986.why_moved: Intensifying worries about the ripple effects of US tariffs and recession risk prompted selling in Asian markets after US declines.

n8e116845ac.headline: Ukrainian, Polish Energy Companies Ink LNG Cooperation Deal
n8e116845ac.summary: Ukrainian and Polish energy companies signed an LNG cooperation agreement. The first step is ORLEN selling about 3.53 Bcf of gas derived from regasifying an LNG cargo.
n8e116845ac.why: ORLEN is Poland's largest integrated oil and gas group, and LNG cooperation affects regional gas supply routes and energy security in Central and Eastern Europe.

n0e066874f3.headline: Intesa Sanpaolo at work on renewal of the board of directors
n0e066874f3.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo's new board of directors is almost finalised, with only a few details left to settle. The presidents of the main shareholder foundations are involved in the process.
n0e066874f3.why: Intesa Sanpaolo is Italy's largest banking group, and board composition affects its governance and strategic direction.

n08d7704149.headline: POLL | What are you expecting from the 2025 budget speech?
n08d7704149.summary: Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana is set to present the revised 2025 budget speech on Wednesday, after it was postponed last month. The budget sets government spending and revenue plans.
n08d7704149.why: The national budget sets spending, taxation and borrowing plans that affect South African bond yields and the rand. Investors watch the fiscal outlook closely.

n8a1f854a1b.headline: Kazakhstan in Talks With Big Oil to Cut Output
n8a1f854a1b.summary: Kazakhstan is engaging major oil companies in discussions to reduce production and align with OPEC+ agreements, aiming to offset significant overproduction.
n8a1f854a1b.why: Kazakhstan is a significant crude producer within OPEC+, and its output decisions affect global oil supply and prices.

n481234d4b5.headline: RTG tables expansion drive after shelling out debt
n481234d4b5.summary: Zimbabwean hospitality group Rainbow Tourism Group (RTG) has repaid heavy debt, creating room for an aggressive expansion within and outside the country. Its CEO discussed the year ended December 31, 2024 results.
n481234d4b5.why: Rainbow Tourism Group is a Zimbabwean hospitality company, and its debt position and expansion plans bear on its funding capacity and growth prospects.

nc60cfa48c5.headline: GoZero Group hits some potholes on the road to electrify its green bus fleet
nc60cfa48c5.summary: Australian green bus firm GoZero has faced multiple obstacles in its goal to electrify all 8,000 New South Wales buses, after its plan to become a public company was dashed.
nc60cfa48c5.why: Bus electrification depends on funding and fleet contracts, and a failed listing can limit the capital a green-transport company can raise.

ncada453eb7.headline: Behind Brazil's 2.4% Retail Growth: Economic Vulnerabilities Remain
ncada453eb7.summary: Brazil's retail sales grew 2.4% in February compared with January, according to Santander Brazil's IGet indicator, though analysts see remaining economic vulnerabilities.
ncada453eb7.why: Retail sales are a key measure of consumer demand, which drives growth and inflation expectations that influence Brazil's central bank policy.

n26d8730ccc.headline: Tariff chaos could push Mexico into technical recession
n26d8730ccc.summary: Mexico's economy appears on track to contract in the first quarter and enter a technical recession, according to analysts. They cite on-again, off-again US tariffs under President Trump.
n26d8730ccc.why: A technical recession means two consecutive quarters of contraction, which affects Mexican assets and the peso, and reflects the country's dependence on US trade.

n6d2889d656.headline: Australia looks to Asian markets as it braces itself for Trump’s tariffs
n6d2889d656.summary: Australia is trying to persuade US President Trump to exempt steel and aluminium from tariffs, as he did in his first term. The government is also looking to Asian markets as it braces for the measures.
n6d2889d656.why: Australia's economy depends heavily on exports of metals and commodities, so US tariffs on steel and aluminium affect trade flows and mining and industrial earnings.

n292d46a3d4.headline: Elon Musk: Taking the chainsaw to his personal portfolio, net worth
n292d46a3d4.summary: Tesla stock lost 15.4% of its value on the day of the report. The article focuses on the impact on Elon Musk's personal net worth.
n292d46a3d4.why: Tesla is a large electric vehicle maker and a heavily weighted US equity, so large moves in its shares affect EV sector sentiment and major indexes.

n8c955e805f.headline: Reps urge CBN to suspend increase in ATM withdrawal charges
n8c955e805f.summary: Nigerian lawmakers have urged the Central Bank of Nigeria to suspend an increase in ATM withdrawal charges. They argue the fees would discourage low-income earners from using banking services.
n8c955e805f.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria regulates the country's banking sector, and changes to banking fees affect consumer access and financial inclusion.

n0ad197a1f0.headline: Gas and LNG remain crucial for Australia’s energy future despite nuclear debate, says Rystad - Invezz
n0ad197a1f0.summary: Rystad Energy says gas and LNG remain crucial for Australia's energy future despite the nuclear debate. The comments come amid ongoing discussion of the country's energy mix.
n0ad197a1f0.why: Rystad Energy is an energy research consultancy, and Australia is a major LNG exporter whose gas policy affects global LNG supply.

n185fe3a1ae.headline: Ford plans €4.4bn investment to revitalise German operations
n185fe3a1ae.summary: Ford plans to invest up to €4.4 billion ($4.8 billion) in its German subsidiary, Ford-Werke. The investment aims to revitalise and increase the competitiveness of the business.
n185fe3a1ae.why: Ford is a major US automaker, and Ford-Werke is its German operating arm, making German investment a signal about European manufacturing strategy.

n1c13fd28ab.headline: Stock markets fall over tariff concerns. And, fentanyl deaths drop in every state
n1c13fd28ab.summary: US stocks fell as investors worried that Trump's tariffs will slow the economy and could lead the United States into recession.
n1c13fd28ab.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.
n1c13fd28ab.why_moved: Investors worried that tariffs will slow the economy and possibly lead the US into recession, prompting a sell-off.

n5df31932eb.headline: Trump Doubles Canada Tariffs In Retaliation To Ontario Edict
n5df31932eb.summary: President Donald Trump announced a plan to double tariffs on Canadian goods as retaliation for an Ontario edict. Details of the measure were not provided.
n5df31932eb.why: Canada is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so tariff changes affect cross-border trade, the Canadian dollar and affected sectors.
n5df31932eb.why_moved: Trump announced a plan to double Canadian tariffs as retaliation to an Ontario edict, escalating the trade dispute.

n2954475ac1.headline: Brazilian Industry Stagnates in January Despite Growth in Most Sectors
n2954475ac1.summary: Brazil's industrial production remained flat in January 2025 compared with December 2024, according to IBGE, despite growth in most sectors.
n2954475ac1.why: Industrial production is a key indicator of Brazil's economic momentum and influences expectations for growth and central bank interest rate decisions.

n76ae026e73.headline: Trump says he'll buy Tesla to show support for Musk
n76ae026e73.summary: Donald Trump has vowed to buy a 'brand new' Tesla to support Elon Musk after the carmaker's troubles were reported. The remark was made publicly.
n76ae026e73.why: Tesla is a major electric vehicle maker whose share price is sensitive to sales, leadership and political attention.

n6efd9b133d.headline: Recession chances are ‘close to 50/50,’ Clinton’s treasury secretary says
n6efd9b133d.summary: Economists warn recession chances are close to 50/50, a former Clinton-era Treasury Secretary says. The warnings come amid uncertainty from Trump's trade war with Mexico, Canada and China.
n6efd9b133d.why: Recession risk shapes corporate earnings expectations, central bank policy and asset allocation across equity and bond markets.

n63c54b369b.headline: Direcional Engenharia Posts Record Q4 Results, Flags Challenges for 2025
n63c54b369b.summary: Brazilian homebuilder Direcional Engenharia released its fourth-quarter earnings on March 10, 2025, posting record results while flagging challenges for 2025.
n63c54b369b.why: Direcional is a Brazilian homebuilder focused on affordable housing, so its results reflect mortgage conditions and construction demand in Brazil.

nae8ae8dd66.headline: SAIC Volkswagen Teramont Pro officially launched, starting at 37,500 USD
nae8ae8dd66.summary: SAIC Volkswagen officially launched its full-size seven-seater intelligent SUV, the Teramont Pro, on March 10, priced from $37,500.
nae8ae8dd66.why: SAIC Volkswagen is a China joint venture between SAIC Motor and Volkswagen, and its model launches reflect competition in China's auto market.

n3dbab04477.headline: Finance Minister to unveil Mahama's 2025 Budget today
n3dbab04477.summary: Finance Minister Cassiel Ato Forson will present the 2025 Budget Statement and Economic Policy to Parliament, the first comprehensive fiscal roadmap of the Mahama administration.
n3dbab04477.why: National budgets set spending, taxation and borrowing plans that shape inflation, debt sustainability and sovereign credit risk.

n30dbe57d25.headline: Ghana scraps IMF-linked
n30dbe57d25.summary: Ghanaian authorities said they are seeking to help citizens struggling with soaring inflation and a depreciating currency. They will introduce alternative measures to enhance tax collection.
n30dbe57d25.why: The IMF oversees Ghana's economic support programme, so changes to IMF-linked policy affect fiscal planning, tax revenue and investor confidence in Ghana.

n2eac12be3b.headline: Iron ore prices rise on hopes of China steel demand rebound - Invezz
n2eac12be3b.summary: Iron ore prices rose on hopes that steel demand in China, the world's largest steel producer, will rebound. The report did not give further detail on the price move.
n2eac12be3b.why: Iron ore is the primary raw material for steel, and China is the largest buyer globally. Its price is a key indicator for mining companies and the construction and manufacturing cycle.

n4024cf054a.summary: Shares of Chinese electric vehicle makers NIO and XPeng surged after a strong sales forecast, according to Invezz. The article does not give figures.

na4cfaf357b.headline: No interest from Bindaree in AA Co’s Darwin plant

na4cfaf357b.why: Bindaree Food Group is an Australian beef processor, and processing plant ownership affects regional cattle markets and export capacity.

nba2755f308.headline: Apparel export to US sees around 46% growth in January
nba2755f308.summary: Bangladesh's apparel exports to the US grew 45.93% in January 2025, with US imports from Bangladesh reaching $799.65 million. Bangladesh is now the fastest-growing apparel exporter to the US.
nba2755f308.why: Apparel is a core export for Bangladesh, and US demand is a major driver of its foreign-exchange earnings.

ne543493be2.headline: Texas introduces third Bitcoin reserve bill, expanding crypto investment for state and local governments
ne543493be2.summary: A third Bitcoin reserve bill has been introduced in Texas, which would expand crypto investment for state and local governments. The proposal is at the legislative stage.
ne543493be2.why: Government bitcoin reserve proposals signal growing public-sector engagement with crypto assets and can influence regulatory direction.

n2f8b7cb562.headline: DWP set to make huge changes to PIP and Universal Credit
n2f8b7cb562.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions is reportedly set to impose stricter criteria for Personal Independence Payments and change how Universal Credit is calculated.
n2f8b7cb562.why: The DWP runs the UK's main welfare payments, and changes to Universal Credit and PIP affect public spending and household income.

n686e21d471.headline: Hedge funds fleeing positions dents European stock traders, say sources
n686e21d471.summary: Hedge funds intensified their fleeing of positions toward the end of last week, according to a JPMorgan note seen by Reuters. The selling may continue to weigh on European hedge fund managers' returns.
n686e21d471.why: Hedge funds are major participants in European equities, and their position changes can affect liquidity and share prices.

n8fffedc2ac.headline: FTSE 100 subdued after selloff; travel and leisure stocks drop
n8fffedc2ac.summary: The FTSE 100 slipped 0.2% on Tuesday while the FTSE 250 rose 0.4%, as gains in the pound offset declines in travel and leisure stocks after the prior session's selloff.
n8fffedc2ac.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of London's largest listed companies, many of which earn revenue globally. Sterling moves affect its multinational constituents.

nc7f6b4472c.headline: An experienced and pragmatic economist to succeed Trudeau (and take on Trump)
nc7f6b4472c.summary: Mark Carney, former governor of the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England, will be sworn in as Canadian prime minister in a few days. He promises firmness in the face of US protectionist attacks.
nc7f6b4472c.why: The Canadian prime minister sets the country's trade and fiscal direction, and the Canada-US trade relationship is central to Canadian equities, the loonie and export sectors.

n3982079263.headline: AI Data Center Build-Out Raises Concerns About America’s Future Power Needs
n3982079263.summary: Annual electricity demand for US data centers is expected to double over four years to 530 TWh, roughly the current power output of Texas. The Epoch Times reports on concerns about future power needs.
n3982079263.why: AI-driven data center build-out is a major source of new electricity demand, affecting utilities, grid investment and power generation companies.

n9d1b56fd79.headline: Aurangzeb, UN officials discuss debt management, climate financing
n9d1b56fd79.summary: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb met UN Resident Coordinator Mohammed Yahya to discuss Pakistan's economy, development, debt management and climate financing. The finance division issued a press release on the meeting.
n9d1b56fd79.why: Pakistan's finance ministry manages the country's public debt and its engagement with multilateral lenders and development agencies, which shape its external financing conditions.

nc6e1021681.headline: Trump escalates trade war with pointless ‘tariff abuser’ Canada: US will ‘just get back’ money
nc6e1021681.summary: Trump called Canada a 'tariff abuser' and said that because US tariffs are reciprocal, the US would 'just get it all back' on April 2, when his tariff plan starts.
nc6e1021681.why: Canada is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so tariff escalations between the two countries affect cross-border trade, supply chains and the Canadian dollar.
nc6e1021681.why_moved: Trump said the tariffs are reciprocal and that the US would get the money back on April 2, when his tariff plan begins. This escalates a trade dispute with Canada.

needbd9927c.headline: PSX loses 178 points
needbd9927c.summary: The KSE-100 index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange lost 178.69 points, or 0.16%, to close at 114,177.66. A total of 318.5 million shares were traded.
needbd9927c.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the performance of its largest listed companies.

nb9640e0931.headline: Tk 6.35bn of ex-PM Hasina’s family in banks frozen
nb9640e0931.summary: Bangladesh's Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit (BFIU) has frozen Tk 6.35 billion held by ex-Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's family in banks, the chief advisor's press secretary said.
nb9640e0931.why: Asset freezes by financial intelligence units affect bank deposits and signal enforcement intensity in the banking system.

n6b47e31c94.headline: No sugar smuggled to Afghanistan, says finmin as Pakistan tightens grip
n6b47e31c94.summary: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said stricter measures against cross-border smuggling mean sugar is being exported to Afghanistan instead of smuggled.
n6b47e31c94.why: Cross-border trade rules and smuggling controls shape commodity flows and the revenue collected by governments.

n8f6f484cd7.headline: SC questions if super tax will continue 'indefinitely'
n8f6f484cd7.summary: A five-member constitutional bench questioned whether the super tax, imposed for a specific purpose, would continue indefinitely during a hearing involving companies.
n8f6f484cd7.why: The super tax falls on high-income earners and companies, so court rulings affect corporate tax liabilities and fiscal policy.

n6abf867bdc.headline: North East radiator firm sees operating profit rise by 17.6 per cent
n6abf867bdc.summary: Newcastle-based radiator manufacturer Stelrad Group reported a 17.6% rise in operating profit in audited results for the year ending December 31, 2024.
n6abf867bdc.why: Stelrad is a UK heating-products maker whose results reflect domestic construction and heating demand, a sector watched by UK small-cap investors.

n5f199bc2cd.headline: Industry ministry to expand trade commission to strengthen trade protection functions
n5f199bc2cd.summary: The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy will reorganise the trade commission to strengthen its trade safeguard functions. The move comes amid ongoing trade pressures.
n5f199bc2cd.why: Trade safeguard bodies investigate unfair trade practices and import surges, which affect exporters and sectors exposed to foreign competition. South Korea is a major trading economy.

nd460ab0782.headline: Uber gives up buying Foodpanda, must pay cancelation fee - Taipei Times
nd460ab0782.summary: Uber Eats is abandoning its plan to acquire Foodpanda's Taiwan delivery business and must pay a US$250 million fee for cancelling the agreement. The original deal was valued at US$950 million.
nd460ab0782.why: Uber is a global ride-hailing and food delivery platform, while Delivery Hero owns Foodpanda in Asia. Large cancelled acquisitions carry financial and regulatory implications for both parties.

n9ba3b8bcfc.headline: Thailand moves to support stock market as it hits post-pandemic low
n9ba3b8bcfc.summary: Thailand's government will introduce measures including tax incentives to support its stock market, which hit a five-year low on Tuesday. An official said the steps will cost the government money.
n9ba3b8bcfc.why: The Stock Exchange of Thailand index reflects the health of the country's largest listed companies and investor sentiment in Southeast Asia.
n9ba3b8bcfc.why_moved: The market hit a five-year low, prompting the government to announce support measures including tax incentives.

n6cc8d81d84.headline: US bonds rose as recession angst fuels haven demand
n6cc8d81d84.summary: Treasuries surged and investors raised their bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate cuts as fears of an economic slowdown spread across US markets.
n6cc8d81d84.why: US Treasuries are the benchmark government bonds for global markets, and their yields reflect expectations for Federal Reserve policy.
n6cc8d81d84.why_moved: Fears of an economic slowdown drove demand for haven assets and raised expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts.

n59d34ace59.headline: PSX flat over policy rate, IMF uncertainty
n59d34ace59.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange index fell 42 points as foreign outflows and an expected inflation surge weighed on sentiment, with the market flat over the policy rate and IMF uncertainty.
n59d34ace59.why: The KSE-100 is the main benchmark of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, and its moves reflect domestic rate policy and IMF program expectations.

naab4f85c9b.headline: Dutch Parliament opposed to Von der Leyen's €800 billion European defense plan
naab4f85c9b.summary: A narrow majority of Dutch parliamentarians signalled they do not support the Cabinet taking part in the European Commission's plan to raise EU defence spending by €800 billion.
naab4f85c9b.why: The Netherlands is a major EU member, and its budget participation would affect how the bloc finances its defence build-up.

n27542ef84e.summary: Greenland's Prime Minister Mute Egede framed the vote as a fateful choice. Polls show most Greenlanders support independence from Denmark, though the timing and speed of any move are debated.

nb352b49797.headline: Petrol price likely to be slashed by Rs15 per litre
nb352b49797.summary: Petrol prices in Pakistan are likely to be cut by Rs15 per litre. The Ministry of Finance would issue a notification if the cut is approved.

na0ab94d0d7.headline: Wall Street falls in a manic day after briefly dropping more than 10% below its record
na0ab94d0d7.summary: The U.S. stock market fell further Tuesday after Trump's latest trade-war escalation, briefly pulling Wall Street 10% below its record set last month, with erratic trading.

n05d6bc4bfa.headline: AirFrance-KLM make a €300 million offer for majority stake in Spanish airline: report

n05d6bc4bfa.why: Air France-KLM is a major European airline group, and consolidation in Spanish aviation would affect its European network and market position.

n28a6fabf2e.headline: Poilievre suggests 50 per cent metal tariffs on U.S. after latest Trump threat

n18b96f5d2f.summary: The Australian share market dropped sharply in early trading but later clawed back some losses, resuming a downward trend.

ne54750bce6.summary: Goldman Sachs projects additional positive revisions to Greece's economic outlook, signaling improving fundamentals.
ne54750bce6.why: Greece's economic upgrades reflect recovery progress post-crisis, impacting investor confidence and sovereign credit conditions.
